title: Greater Goods High Capacity Kitchen Scale, A Premium Food Scale, Weighs in Grams and Ounces with 22 Pound Capacity, Hi-Def LCD Screen, and Stainless Steel Platform
description:
About this item
A Premium Choice: Going above and beyond on all qualities you need and expect in a food scale. Enjoy a large, ultra-accurate, single sensor weighing platform; responsive, touch buttons; and a sturdy build—ready for any accidents that might come its way.
Built for Bulk: A kitchen scale that weighs up to twenty-two pounds will never let you down. Do all your bulk food measurements and prep, and—while you’re at it—use it for any chore around the house you need to measure the weight of an object for; this little guy can handle it!
Diverse Functionality: Everything you could possibly need a food scale for. A single gram resolution, four units of measurement–grams, ounces, milliliters, and pounds—as well as a tare function for zeroing the weight of objects on top, and a hold function, so the screen will stay on extra long for you.
Simple and Stylish: Never let a kitchen accessory cramp your style again. The sleek, modern design of this bulk food scale fits right in with the decor of even the trendiest space. Your counter will never look better measuring ingredients, thanks to the hi-def VA LCD display and some vibrant, chrome accents courtesy of the stainless steel weighing platform.
True Support: Our friendly team in St. Louis are industry experts at-the-ready to assist you with any questions that might arise about your food scale. We take pride in our work and want you to have a great experience from beginning to end.

reviews_5s:
I started my homestead journey two years ago and I couldn't live without this scale! It's perfect for baking bread and canning. The scale is very accurate! Super easy to use and clean. It is also the perfect size. Not to big and not to small! It perfectly fits in my kitchen drawer. I suggest buying this item if you love spending time in the kitchen.Easy to use and precise. I almost sent it back when I received it because based on the main product image I expected the scale to be larger and I need to weigh bulky items. Fortunately, after giving it a whirl I believe it will meet my needs.

I couldn't (and still can't) find dimensions on the product page. Post purchase I asked Rufus (the Amazon shopping assistant) for the dimensions and received this response, "The product dimensions are 7.87 x 6.1 x 1.46 inches, with a 5.5 x 5.5 inch weighing platform, according to the product information." That is reasonably accurate.

The design is great and the precision is spot on. I used a 50 gram calibration weight and tested zeroing out the scale with a variety of weights and the scale returned a value within a gram even with heavier tests. In the photo you can see that with the scale zeroed with the orange the weight yields a result of 50g from the scale.

I do wish the scale were a bit larger as it will be a little challenging to weigh some of the bulkier items.

Top notch!Quality product. You can see it in the packaging. It's like opening a new cell phone. I like that. The quality is great. Definitely will buy again! Thank you. Nice packaging too😊Muy prácticoEasy to use and at a good priceThis little scale can do a big job! It has been so helpful to me as I'm now making food for my elderly dog, and have to weigh protein and measure the vegetables, etc. Someone complained that hitting the on/off button doesn't shut it off, but it does, you just have to hold it for a couple of seconds to turn it off. I highly recommend buying this scale.The scale is an excellent product, with the option to weigh items in several different units. It is easy to clean with a quick wipe and storage is simple as it has a small form factor. It functions as intended for our needs. The price is acceptable as Greater Goods sells quality products. I can see using this product for a long time as it is made to last.I felt I need to "weigh" in on this product after receiving it. It is just a scale .... however I had such a positive first impression I thought I would share.

1. Packaging: The packaging was such as to give then impression that this company really cares about making quality products. The box not only performs the function of protecting the product during shipping but is made of high quality materials with a zip pull to open. There was substantial rubber/foam cushioning between the weigh plate and the rest of the unit to protect the sensor from impacts and vibration during shipping. The display was protected with a film to prevent potential scratching during shipping. A card encouraging registering the product for a 5 YEAR WARRANTY. The packing materials look and felt nice.

2. SCALE: This scale has an LED backlight that sets is apart from its competitors making it not only much easier to read but also provides a touch of elegance. The buttons are touch sensitive an seem to work we well. Sometimes membrane click buttons used on other scales are persnickety. There are multiple units selection Pounds (1.25 pounds), pounds and ounces 1 pound 4.0 oz), ounces ( 20 oz) grams ( 567 grams) and several liquid measures). I really like that this scale remembers the last unit of measure used when you turn it off and back on again. My last scale made me reselect the units each time it turned it on. There are two buttons. One button is the power/ zero button. Touch to turn on, touching while on zero the scale (tare). Press and hold 3 seconds to turn off. The other button it the Unit/Hold button. Touch briefly to cycle through and select the different units, press an hold the button to hold (freeze) the weight on the display.

Summary:
While it is "just" a scale, the design is well thought out. It looks and feels nice. It is one of those products that just does its job and does not demand that you think about it. You only notice how good it is when you use another scale and miss this one. Purchased this on sale for almost $22. A little higher than other scales but at this juncture i feel well worth the difference. I have no opinion at the point as to accuracy and battery life. I suspect accuracy is not an issue given the attention to detail of the manufacturer.This is the perfect little kitchen scale. Stores easy. Easy to operate and tare.I haven't used it very much, yet but, it does seem to be a superior scale to the one I had before. I can put a dish on it to weigh with & it zeros out quickly. Changing the units is also very easy & I don't have to wait for it to shut itself off. There's an on/off button for that. I hope it has good longevity.
reviews_1s:
This scale is extremely frustrating. It takes a long time to "land" on a number, and I don't even have confidence that it is accurate. It jumps from 6g to 14g and every number in between while trying to measure one ingredient. It doesn't even stay on 0 for very long before jumping to 2 or -2 with nothing on it. If you're using it to track your macros, I suggest looking for a better scale like I will be.I was really excited to start using the Greater Goods High Capacity Kitchen Scale for my bread baking. I thought it would help me get all my measurements just right. But, I quickly found out it wasn't as great as I hoped. The big problem? It doesn't handle water well at all, which is pretty bad for something you use in the kitchen. Plus, it wasn't giving me the right numbers. One minute, my dough would weigh 35 grams, and the next, it could jump up to 40 grams or drop down to 30 grams. This made baking more like guessing, and that's not good when you're trying to be exact.

The fact that the scale can't deal with water is a big issue. Even a little bit of water from cleaning can mess up the screen, making it hard to read. That's not what you want from a kitchen scale. It's supposed to be accurate and easy to use, even when things get messy. This scale promised to be really precise and handle a lot of weight, but it just doesn't live up to that promise because of these problems. If you need a scale that's reliable for baking or cooking where you need to measure things exactly, you might want to look for a different one. A scale that doesn't give you the same number every time and can't handle a splash of water is more trouble than it's worth.I’ve had the same less than 3 months. It told me the battery was low. I replaced the batteries it still says low. I tried different batteries with the same result. Return policy is only 30 days.My daughter is a baker and was very excited to receive this product. Unfortunately, the weight shown on this scale varies dramatically depending on where on the scale platform the measuring container is placed. Even using another scale to figure out the correct placement was impossible. We will try another design.This scale is awful. It's not sensitive enough to operate in single digit gram increments. It routinely jumps a digit when weighing (e.g. at 19 grams, target 20. Scale will never read 20, only 19 or 21. My dog weighs 9 pounds and we weigh her food by grams. 2 grams is 10% of her food per feeding. It also measures the tare weight of her bowl as either 83 grams or 85 grams depending on the day. The bowl is known to be 83 grams across multiple scales.Hate this scale. It S L O W L Y increments it's way to the weight on it. I was trying to weigh out 8 oz of a loose product and had to wait 10-15 seconds after each scoop to see what the resulting weight was.

Garbage. Ugh. Didn't use it until after return period expired.I weigh most of my food every day. The scale for the most part seems good but it has some consistency issues. I’ve been using it for about a month now and numerous times I have come back and weighed something and it weighs differently.. scale is always on flat surface and I have tared it. It’s happened at least 4 times in a month. The first time or two I considered I made an error but at this point I know it was the scale. I used the very common Ozeri scale for many years before it died and never once had this issue.I have to take the battery in and out almost every time. When I turn it on without removing them and putting them back in it either does not weigh anything or the weight is wrong. I contacted them about this months ago and received no response. I now have zero confidence in the measurement it gives me.This thing is good enough for measuring things when dry, but the capacitive touch buttons render it completely useless if you a) clean it or b) measure wet things and get moisture on it. You try to clean it off with something moist? Well the moisture seeps in to the buttons and then it will be randomly turning off, changing units, zeroing, and all that for seemingly no reason - even when the device appears to be dry. Avoid this by all means and buy something with proper BUTTONS not this touch crap. Good luck using it if you ever clean it because it will never dry out completely and just be busted.I got the Greater Goods High Capacity Kitchen Scale with stainless scale with a higher cost hoping to get a higher quality scale. Unfortunately the scale is highly not responsive and inaccurate. I mostly use it for kitchen/baking and measuring out herbs in grams. The reading stuck at a number (e.g. 2g or 3g), and would not increase with more material added. It moves in a jumpy fashion, 2g -> 5g, which nothing in between. Additionally when I move the item away from the scale and put the same item back, it reports a totally different number (e.g. 6g and 9g for the same item). It's a headache to have this scale in the kitchen.
